PMF.iid: The n-fold iid law of p on a finite alphabet is the law of a length-n word with independent coordinates of common law p. The mass of x is ∏ᵢ p(xᵢ).
PMF.finiteProduct_map_append_symm: Split a product word over a finite alphabet after the first m of its m+n coordinates. The two blocks are independent, and each retains the coordinate laws of its positions in the original word.
PMF.channelJoint_finiteProduct_map_appen: Concatenating independent product words of lengths m and n over the same finite alphabet gives a product word whose first m coordinate laws come from p and whose last n come from q.
PMF.iid_map_perm: For a law p on a finite alphabet, permuting the coordinates of a word drawn from n independent copies of p preserves its law.
